propositions: review_interrupts metric is currently dimensionless and does not distinguish between bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) and signal-unavailable (health probe broken, deploys running blind), making it impossible for a CloudWatch-only sweep to determine which remediation applies

observability.sh must emit two new metrics review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable by filtering AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT journal entries on their reason field using the existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with new offset files

monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two separate alarms (one per reason), each carrying only its own remediation, while keeping the rolled-up review_interrupts metric published but unalarmed to prevent double-paging
signal-unavailable alarm must retain evaluation_periods=1 and datapoints_to_alarm=1 to remain promptly alarming for the urgent case of blind deploys
terraform apply must be executed by an operator to activate the new alarm configuration on the live account, as the implementing agent cannot mutate infrastructure
